text:
You need a developer who can consult on and implement a custom ChatGPT plugin end to end, and I can help with both the planning and the build.

I’m Noor Halden, and I have 6 years of experience building Python-based AI systems with OpenAI API, LangChain, machine learning, and NLP. I’ve worked on production assistants that combine retrieval, tool use, and handoff logic, which maps closely to the kind of plugin-based workflow you’re looking to create.

In my recent work on a Delivery support chatbot for Parcelwise Logistics, I built a WhatsApp and SMS assistant using Python, OpenAI API, LangGraph, FastAPI, Redis, and Twilio. It tracked parcels, rescheduled deliveries, and handed off to a human with full context. That system resolved 43% of conversations without an agent and achieved a CSAT of 4.4 out of 5.

I also built a Contract clause search assistant for a confidential legal client using Python, LangChain, OpenAI API, pgvector, PostgreSQL, and FastAPI. It answered questions over 9,000 contracts and always quoted the clause and page it used. On a 120-question lawyer-written test set, it reached 0.91 faithfulness, and it reduced clause lookup time from 25 minutes to 3 minutes.

For your project, I can help with the initial 2-hour consulting milestone to shape the plugin architecture, clarify the OpenAI/plugin requirements, and outline the implementation approach. Then I can move into the full build of the ChatGPT plugin itself, including the API integration, tool design, and the supporting backend needed for reliable behavior.

My approach is practical and implementation-focused: keep the plugin narrow enough to be dependable, make the responses grounded in your data or workflow, and design the backend so it is maintainable after launch.

If you want someone who has built real AI assistants and can translate your plugin idea into a working implementation, I’d be glad to discuss the next steps.
